semantic_policy.provenance: Initial vehicle-agnostic planning priors, not RELLIS-3D annotations and not learned costs. Values must be reviewed for the target vehicle and task.
semantic_policy.label_encoding: Exact uint32 values are used. No undocumented SemanticKITTI bit mask is applied.

0.name: void
0.rationale: Unlabeled evidence is uncertain rather than assumed free.

1.name: dirt
1.rationale: Usually intended off-road driving surface; vehicle-specific traction is not encoded.

3.name: grass
3.rationale: Potentially traversable but less certain than compact dirt.

6.name: water
6.rationale: Depth and support are unknown, so the initial policy forbids it.

7.name: sky
7.rationale: Not a terrain return; ignored when choosing a cell class.

9.name: object
9.rationale: Unspecified above-ground object is conservatively forbidden.

10.name: asphalt
10.rationale: Typically compact and smooth when geometry agrees.

15.name: log
15.rationale: Above-ground obstacle for the initial vehicle-agnostic policy.

19.name: bush
19.rationale: Geometry and penetrability are uncertain; treated conservatively.

23.name: concrete
23.rationale: Potentially traversable surface when slope and occupancy agree.

31.name: puddle
31.rationale: Unknown depth and traction; discouraged but not asserted physically impassable.

33.name: mud
33.rationale: Potential loss of traction; value is a tunable initial prior.

34.name: rubble
34.rationale: Irregular support and clearance risk; geometry remains an independent term.
